originalTitle: Will a fully error corrected quantum computer capable of running 100 million gates be created before 2030?
title: 2030 年前会出现可执行一亿个门的纠错量子计算机吗？
Will an error-corrected quantum computer capable of 100 million gates exist before 2030?
rules: 原文要求在 2030-01-01 当日或之前，公告具备有效纠错和一亿门能力的量子计算机，并有非零第三方验证；未附加其他性能要求。

The description requires an announcement on or before 2030-01-01 of effective error correction and 100-million-gate capability, with nonzero third-party verification and no further performance conditions.
interpretation: 标题写“2030 年前”，正文含 1 月 1 日当日；门的种类与验证强度并未完整量化。
The title says before 2030; the description includes 1 January. Gate type and verification strength are not fully quantified.

summary: 原题把有效纠错、长电路能力和第三方验证放在一起；逻辑存储器突破并不单独满足这些条件。
The question combines effective correction, long-circuit capability and third-party verification; a logical-memory result alone is insufficient.
checklist: 核对门数是物理门还是逻辑门。
Check whether counts refer to physical or logical gates.
查看纠错是否在长电路中有效运行。
Verify effective correction during long circuits.
核实公告、独立验证及截止日期。
Verify the announcement, third-party checks and deadline.

impact: Willow 的阈值以下存储实验提供了纠错可扩展性的具体证据。评估一亿门目标还需看逻辑运算、解码和长程序错误，而非只比较物理比特数量。

Willow provides specific evidence for scalable correction in a memory. The 100-million-gate target additionally requires logical operations, decoding and long-program error evidence rather than physical-qubit counts alone.
gap: 原题对门数与第三方验证定义较宽，保留规则不足提示。
The gate and verification definitions remain broad and are flagged.

title: 物理比特、逻辑存储与逻辑运算
Physical qubits, logical memory and logical operations
principle: 逻辑比特由多个物理比特编码，并通过重复测量和解码识别错误。逻辑存储器保持信息，与执行长串通用逻辑门是不同任务；门数也必须说明是物理门还是逻辑门。

Logical qubits encode information across physical qubits using repeated measurement and decoding. Preserving a memory differs from executing long general circuits; gate counts must identify physical or logical operations.
example: Willow 研究通过增大表面码距离观察逻辑错误的抑制。一亿门市场还要求对具备纠错能力的计算机进行公告和第三方验证，不能仅用芯片比特数或随机线路基准替代。

Willow tests logical-error suppression as code distance increases. The 100-million-gate contract additionally requires an announcement and third-party verification, rather than chip size or a random-circuit benchmark.
